facts.text: Under the Guaranteed Admission Agreement, Virginia Community College System students graduating with a transfer-oriented associate degree and a 2.5 GPA earn guaranteed admission to ODU.

sources.title: Guaranteed Admission | Old Dominion University
sources.quote: The Guaranteed Admission Agreement is intended to ease the transfer process between the Virginia Community College System (VCCS) and Old Dominion University (ODU).

sources.title: Guaranteed Admission | Old Dominion University
sources.quote: Graduate with a minimum of a 2.5 cumulative GPA (as computed under VCCS policy) in a transfer-oriented or articulated applied associate degree program from a Virginia community college
